ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in rectangle $ABCD$, points $E$ and $F$ are respectively on sides $AD$ and $DC$, $\triangle ABE\sim \triangle DEF$, $DF>DE$, $AB=9$, $AE=12$, $DE=3$, what is the length of $FC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that $\triangle ABE\sim \triangle DEF$, \\
therefore $\frac{AB}{DE}=\frac{AE}{DF}$, \\
since $AB=9$, $AE=12$, and $DE=3$, \\
then $\frac{9}{3}=\frac{12}{DF}$, \\
solving this gives $DF=4$, \\
since quadrilateral $ABCD$ is a rectangle, \\
therefore $DC=AB=9$, \\
thus $FC=DC−DF=9−4=\boxed{5}$.
